items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Who did the arrangements? Andy Gibson, and he tried to copy as close as he could, but most of them were Duke's things.

ctx.x: Andy Gibson, and he tried to copy as close as he could, but most of them were Duke's things. But Barnet always did have a good band. He would hire good men. He'd pay them well. It's ironic, but I remember Barnet -- he didn't have a lot of hit records or anything, but I made more money than I made with -- ever made with Lunceford, you know.
